topics.topic_name: TLS/SSL cipher suite and server-client compatibility
topics.justification: Words such as "server", "client", "cipher", "suite", "openssl", "certificate", "protocol", and legacy items like "rc4" point to configuring and selecting TLS cipher suites/parameters based on support and secure defaults.

topics.topic_name: Key generation and encryption in application code (passwords, hashing, randomness)
topics.justification: Frequent terms like "key", "encrypt/encryption", "password", "hash", "random", "generate", "byte", and "file/message" suggest implementation-focused questions about generating keys, encrypting data, and handling password-derived keys securely.

topics.topic_name: Key size, bit security level, and block/round parameters
topics.justification: The dominance of "key", "bit", "size", and "length" plus "block", "round", "block_size", and "strength" indicates discussions about choosing security parameters (e.g., key lengths) and how they relate to practical attack limits and recommendations.
